title: polypodium ussuriense
intro: Polypodium ussuriense, commonly known as Ussuri Polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures, where it is valued for its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Ussuri Polypody include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Ussuri Polypody include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial effects.
